text: 据每日经济新闻，继新开户环节要求确认资金来源为境外合法渠道后，有在港银行已开始对部分存量内地投资客户启动资金来源声明程序。记者获悉，汇丰香港近日已陆续向部分内地存量投资客户发出通知，要求其于9月12日之前通过汇丰香港App提交《开立/维持账户之声明书》，并更新联系信息。声明书内容包括确认投资活动资金来自中国内地以外地区的合法来源、银行可应执法或监管机构要求披露个人资料等。
text_en: According to National Business Daily, following the new account opening process requiring confirmation that funds come from legitimate overseas sources, some banks in Hong Kong have begun requiring existing mainland investment clients to declare their source of funds. A reporter learned that HSBC Hong Kong has recently been sending notices to some existing mainland investment clients, requiring them to submit a "Declaration for Opening/Maintaining Accounts" via the HSBC Hong Kong app by September 12 and update contact information. The declaration confirms that funds for investment activities come from legitimate sources outside mainland China and that the bank may disclose personal information at the request of law enforcement or regulatory authorities.
